newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD STEEPLECHASE CHAMPION KIPKETER.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD STEEPLECHASE CHAMPION KIPKETER.

text.p: Profile of William Boit Kipketer, who won the world 3,000 metres steeplechase title on Wednesday.
Improved in 1996 from a time of eight minutes 27.90 set at altitude in 1994 to 8:11.29.
Improved his personal best in Wednesday's final, which he won in 8:05.84.
Known as Wilson Boit Kipketer to distinguish him from world 800 metres champion Wilson Kipketer.
